 Free Medicare Open Enrollment Session at Camp Jefferson
 By Frank Cahill 
 November 16, 2026 
 0 
 21 
 Share 
 Facebook Twitter Pinterest WhatsApp Linkedin ReddIt Email Print Copy URL 
 File Photo 
 Advertisements 
 Advertisements 
 JEFFERSON TOWNSHIP — Residents with questions about Medicare can get help during a Medicare Open Enrollment session on Tuesday, November 17, from 11:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. at Camp Jefferson, 81 Weldon Road, Lake Hopatcong.
 The session will be presented by Thai Nguyen of the State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP), which helps residents navigate their Medicare options.
 The program is offered by Jefferson Township in partnership with the Jefferson Township Public Library, the Mayor’s Wellness Campaign, SHIP, NORWESCAP RSVP and AmeriCorps Seniors.
 Registration is requested. To register, call (973) 208-6244 or click here .
